name: neoload
description:
Hello team,

For the upcoming performance test we’ll be using three global variables: the base URL is set to **https://api.example.com**, the login credentials are **username = testuser** and **password = secret**. These values will be referenced throughout the script as ${baseUrl}, ${username} and ${password}.

The test script, named **LoginScenario**, models the typical user login flow. It begins with an HTTP POST request to **${baseUrl}/login**, sending a JSON payload that includes the username and password fields, and it includes a “Content‑Type: application/json” header. After a think time of 2 seconds, the script issues an HTTP GET request to **${baseUrl}/dashboard** and pauses for 1 second before completing. The scenario will simulate **100 users** ramping up over **60 seconds**.
